auto_download.tooltip: Download missing model files from Hugging Face and the original publishers.

keep_on_gpu.tooltip: Keep the weights on the GPU between runs (faster repeats, less VRAM for other models). They are released when ComfyUI frees its model and node cache.

vram_reserve_gb.tooltip: VRAM left untouched when choosing the temporal window size automatically.

CorridorKey2ModelLoader.name: CorridorKey2ModelLoader
CorridorKey2ModelLoader.description: Loads CorridorKey 2.0 and its three foundation models (C-RADIO, MoGe-2, RVM). Missing files are downloaded into models/corridorkey2 on first use (about 5.1 GB).
